Container.Name: Jellygate
Container.Overview: Bridges Jellyfin authentication into Aurral through a trusted reverse proxy gateway.
Container.Description: Jellygate authenticates users against Jellyfin, issues its own gateway session, and proxies into Aurral with trusted identity headers.

Config.Name: AppData
Config.Description: Container app data

Config.Name: Port
Config.Description: Jellygate HTTP port

Config.Name: HOST
Config.Description: Bind host

Config.Name: PORT
Config.Description: Internal listen port

Config.Name: APP_NAME
Config.Description: Display name used in the login flow

Config.Name: APP_VERSION
Config.Description: Application version label

Config.Name: UI_BASE_PATH
Config.Description: Path for the bundled UI assets

Config.Name: JELLYFIN_URL
Config.Description: Internal Jellyfin URL reachable from the container

Config.Name: JELLYFIN_PUBLIC_URL
Config.Description: Public Jellyfin URL used for the bridge handoff

Config.Name: JELLYFIN_BRIDGE_PATH
Config.Description: Jellyfin plugin helper route used for existing-session handoff

Config.Name: AURRAL_URL
Config.Description: Internal Aurral URL reachable from the container

Config.Name: COOKIE_NAME
Config.Description: Gateway session cookie name

Config.Name: COOKIE_SECRET
Config.Description: Long random secret used to sign the Jellygate session cookie

Config.Name: COOKIE_SECURE
Config.Description: Set to false if you need to test over plain HTTP before public TLS is live

Config.Name: HANDOFF_SECRET
Config.Description: Long random secret shared with the Jellyfin bridge plugin

Config.Name: SESSION_TTL_SECONDS
Config.Description: Gateway session lifetime in seconds

Config.Name: ALLOW_PASSWORD_LOGIN
Config.Description: Allow direct Jellyfin username/password login on the Jellygate host

Config.Name: ALLOW_JELLYFIN_HANDOFF
Config.Description: Allow existing-session handoff via the Jellyfin bridge plugin

Config.Name: SIGNUP_URL
Config.Description: Optional account creation URL shown on the login page

Config.Name: PASSWORD_RESET_URL
Config.Description: Optional password reset URL shown on the login page
